pages.title: Scan, Disc, Print
pages.text: $(l)Scan$() a build with the Structure Scanner, save it to a $(l)disc$(), then $(l)print$() it anywhere.$(br2)Shift+Right Click a written disc to $(l)lock$() it.$(br2)Discs also drop from structure chests and archaeology, and loot never repeats a build you have.

pages.title: Naming & Tier
pages.text: A disc shows its $(l)tier$(): the highest material tier among its blocks, and so the lowest machine that can print it.$(br2)It also shows a $(l)Print Cost$() in that tier. Water, fire, farmland and paths are free; crops cost their seed.$(br2)Rename one in an $(item)Anvil$() for 1 level. $(l)Trophy items$() are never duplicated.

pages.title: Import & Export
pages.text: Operators can exchange blueprints with other tools:$(br)$(li)$(o)/mc3dprint import <file>$() reads WorldEdit $(l).schem$(), Litematica $(l).litematic$(), and Create / vanilla $(l).nbt$() files from $(o)world/mc3dprint/import/$()$(li)$(o)/mc3dprint export$() writes the disc in your hand to a $(l).schem$()$(br2)Shipped blueprints live in $(o)world/mc3dprint/blueprints/$().
